g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Average time spent in a 24-hour day by people aged 15 to 64. Based on

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: each country's most recent time-use survey in the OECD data, from

font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Figures are averaged across everyone aged 15 to 64, including people who don't work or

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: study, and across all days of the week. The OECD groups each country's survey activities into

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: common categories, but differences between the surveys can still affect comparisons.
